transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yeah, hi. There's a forty five dollar charge on my ApexPay card from CloudStream Pro. I NEVER signed up for that! And my rent is due TOMORROW. I need it reversed. Today!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: Thank you for calling. Um, I am so sorry about that, Jordan. Can you please tell me your full name and the last 4 digits of your card so I can help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Jordan Reynolds! The card ends in 4 4 1 7. Just fix it!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: So, I understand how stressful this is with rent due tomorrow. I will get this dispute started for you right away.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: "Starting" it isn't enough! I need that money back in my account NOW. When exactly will it be reversed?

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I am so sorry, Jordan. You should see a provisional credit in your account within 2 business days.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Two business days?! Are you serious? My rent is due TOMORROW! I can't wait two days!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I m am so sorry, I really am. I will take

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Stop with the apologies! They don't fix anything! Tell me EXACTLY what you're going to do to get it done today!

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: ownership of this and see what I can do to speed things up for you.

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: I am so sorry, Jordan. I will block CloudStream Pro from your card right now and send you a new card today.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wait. You JUST said you'd fix the credit! Blocking them is one thing, but what about my money? When is the credit arriving?

transcript.speaker: Candidate
transcript.text: Um, I'll make sure the credit is processed immediately. Your dispute reference number is 829433.

cefrRationale: The candidate communicates effectively but shows significant struggles with pacing and managing emotional intensity.
summary: The candidate successfully followed the technical requirements of the script and showed strong empathy by acknowledging the rent concern. However, the candidate's extremely fast speaking pace and tendency to overpromise on immediate processing led to a failed de-escalation.

findings.quote: Um, I'll make sure the credit is processed immediately.
findings.coaching: Be careful not to overpromise on timelines that contradict the established policy, such as saying you will process it immediately when the policy is two days.

findings.quote: I am so sorry, Jordan. You should see a provisional credit in your account within 2 business days.
findings.coaching: Slow down your speaking rate; 231 words per minute is much too fast for a stressful customer interaction.

findings.quote: I will block CloudStream Pro from your card right now and send you a new card today.
findings.coaching: Ensure you provide a clear, structured path forward rather than jumping between different solutions like blocking a merchant and sending a card.

scriptSteps.step: Thank the caller for calling ApexPay and give your name
scriptSteps.quote: Thank you for calling. Um, I am so sorry about that, Jordan.

scriptSteps.step: Verify identity: full name and the last four digits of the card
scriptSteps.quote: Can you please tell me your full name and the last 4 digits of your card so I can help?

scriptSteps.step: Acknowledge the specific worry (the rent due tomorrow)
scriptSteps.quote: So, I understand how stressful this is with rent due tomorrow.

scriptSteps.step: Explain the dispute: provisional credit posts within two business days
scriptSteps.quote: You should see a provisional credit in your account within 2 business days.

scriptSteps.step: Block the merchant and offer a replacement card
scriptSteps.quote: I will block CloudStream Pro from your card right now and send you a new card today.

scriptSteps.step: Ask if there is anything else and close by thanking them for calling ApexPay
